role: extra-target scan from the multi-target hit loop
limits: Executes the native scanner through its actual return, class/radius/priority methods, clipping default fragment and final attack predicate. One supplied candidate array and per-candidate eligibility are controlled; spatial indexing and full native eligibility are not emulated.

Minimal source-selected objects/Data are supplied as in the pinned target-type capture. Source Range/MinimumRange/SightRange/Speed/CollisionRadius/TargetOnlyBuildings/SightClip/SightClipSide are supplied, with other profile/Globals modifiers zero. Complete Data loading, movement and inherited profiles remain outside scope.

Native team indices0/1 are numeric controls, not mapped to browser player colors. Buff mask zero excludes team inversion. Bodies use controlled state2; this does not establish the full live caller or state machine.
Collection order, current-target exclusion and recursion depth are controlled. Browser movement destinations or existing-lock retention must not be inferred directly from this attack scanner.

The retained caller identifies this as extra-target selection during multi-target hits. It is not the primary-lock scanner at0x25deb6; its center-distance comparison and final-range veto must not be generalized to primary acquisition.

blocks.name: nativePriority
blocks.interpretation: Character owners with TargetOnlyBuildings prefer stationary targets; otherwise priority0.

blocks.name: clipDefaults
blocks.interpretation: Missing/zero SightClip becomes1000, then zero-speed owners clear it. This fragment executes with the source Data pointer.

blocks.name: ownerTeam
blocks.interpretation: With the buff mask controlled zero, returns body+0x1c team index.

blocks.name: teamOrientation
blocks.interpretation: Returns true for even team index; source coordinates retain native orientation.

blocks.name: absoluteSideDistance
blocks.interpretation: Native absolute integer lateral distance for side clipping.

blocks.name: clipAndRank
blocks.interpretation: Apply directional clipping, then prefer larger priority and strictly smaller squared center distance; ties retain collection order.

blocks.name: currentAndRecursiveExclusion
blocks.interpretation: Skip assigned current target and, when depth>0, the preceding recursive scan result.

25da7c:	e8 dd fe ff ff       	call   25d95e

blocks.interpretation: Revalidate eligibility and native attack range only for the nominated candidate; return null on failure without retrying the next candidate.

blocks.name: extraTargetCaller
blocks.interpretation: The hit loop calls this scanner with recursive depth, applies hit index+1, and iterates Data+0x2e4 minus one. Primary lock acquisition instead calls0x25deb6.
